I don’t have the exact Northwest Federal Credit Union app screens, but here’s the most likely path in their mobile app. Follow these steps:

1) Sign in and open your card
- Open the NWFCU app and sign in with Face ID as usual.
- On the home / accounts screen, look for your credit card (likely “Rewards Card” or similar, ending in ****4321).
- Tap that card to open its details.

2) Look for card controls / manage card
On the card details screen, look for one of these:
- “Card Controls” or “Manage Card”
- A small gear ⚙️ / settings icon
- A menu button (three dots •••) near the card name or balance

Tap that and look for:
- “Report Lost Card”
- “Report Lost/Stolen”
- “Replace Card”
If you see both “Lost” and “Stolen”, choose **Lost**.

3) Report the card as lost
Once you tap the lost/stolen option:
- Confirm the specific card (make sure it shows the right last 4 digits).
- When asked what happened, choose **Lost** (not stolen).
- Confirm that you want the card **blocked immediately**.

4) Request / confirm replacement card
The app may:
- Automatically offer to send a replacement, or
- Ask whether you want a replacement shipped.

In that flow:
- Choose **Yes** to replacement.
- Verify your **mailing address on file** is correct.
- Confirm the request. If you see an estimated delivery date, note it.

5) Double-check the card is blocked
After submitting:
- Go back to the card screen.
- The card may show as **locked/blocked** or “Inactive” / “Restricted”.
- Try to see if there’s a status like “Lost” or “Replacement ordered” in the details or messages section.

If you can’t find “Report lost/stolen” in the app:
- In the app, look for **Support**, **Help**, or **Contact Us**.
- There may be:
  - A **secure message** option: send a message saying:
    “Please report my Northwest Federal Credit Union credit card ending in 4321 as LOST. I noticed it missing this morning; I don’t see any suspicious transactions. Please block it immediately and send a replacement to the address on file.”
  - Or a **phone number** for “Lost or Stolen Cards” – tap to call and tell them the same thing.

After you try these steps, tell me:
- Which step you got to, and
- What options you see on the card screen (I can help interpret or find the next spot).</action>
